$comment: The guides published from docs/guides/ (and translated in docs/guides/zh/), in sidebar order. Each slug is a basename (without .md) and becomes /<slug> in English and /zh/<slug> in Simplified Chinese. Read by src/lib/guides.ts and scripts/check-links.mjs. Each section's title is localized by locale code (en, zh). sidebarTitles[locale] overrides a page's sidebar label in that language (its H1 title otherwise); keep labels short enough for one sidebar line, in sentence case in English except for domain terms such as Host. The GuideCard links in content/index.mdx and content/zh/index.mdx show the same localized sidebar label and shared icon. seo[locale][slug] optionally overrides HTML <title> (seoTitle) and <meta name="description"> (seoDescription) without altering the visible H1 or raw GitHub Markdown files. icons names the Lucide icon (https://lucide.dev/icons, PascalCase) shown beside each page in the sidebar; every page needs one.

index.seoTitle: Heeler Docs — iPhone & iPad Console for Claude Code, Codex, herdr & tmux
index.seoDescription: Set up Heeler on iPhone and iPad to monitor and control Claude Code, Codex, and other coding agents over SSH with Herdr TUI, herdr-core, tmux, or Rex.

pairing.seoTitle: Pair a Mac or Linux Host via QR Code over SSH
pairing.seoDescription: Connect iPhone or iPad to a Mac or Linux Host over SSH by scanning a one-time Pairing Code from the Heeler plugin or npx heeler-pair—no manual key setup.

tmux.seoTitle: Connect tmux on macOS or Linux over SSH
tmux.seoDescription: Monitor and control Claude Code, Codex, Grok Build, Pi, and Oh My Pi with native Chat (and OpenCode in the terminal) on macOS or Linux tmux 3.3+, plus hooks and Host Helper.

herdr-core.seoTitle: Connect herdr-core and Herdr Desktop App over SSH
herdr-core.seoDescription: Connect Heeler over SSH to the Herdr desktop app or headless herdr-core on macOS, Linux, and native Windows, with native Chat and macOS/Linux Host Helper notifications and Usage.

windows-setup.seoTitle: Windows 11 Setup: OpenSSH and Native Herdr TUI
windows-setup.seoDescription: Enable Win32-OpenSSH, firewall rules, and native Herdr TUI auto-start on Windows 11 for live Agents and terminals in Heeler, plus paths to Windows herdr-core and Rex.

tailscale.seoTitle: Connect Heeler over Tailscale Without an iOS VPN App
tailscale.seoDescription: Join your tailnet with Heeler's built-in Tailscale node so iPhone and iPad need no Tailscale app or iOS VPN slot, including optional VPN-free userspace Tailscale on Mac.

usage.seoTitle: Track Claude Code, Codex & Antigravity CLI Usage Widgets
usage.seoDescription: View Claude Code, Codex, and Antigravity CLI Usage Limits and 30-day Token Usage on iPhone and iPad Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets on macOS and Linux Hosts.

chat.seoTitle: Native Chat for Claude Code, Codex & Coding Agents
chat.seoDescription: Read conversations, send prompts, stop turns, and answer Blocked prompts with buttons in Heeler's native Chat over SSH across Herdr TUI, herdr-core, tmux, and Rex.

chat-troubleshooting.seoDescription: Fix common Heeler Chat issues including missing Show Chat, Codex Started Without --no-daemon, Can't Tell the Conversation, custom Account folders, and SFTP uploads.

rex.seoDescription: Connect Heeler over SSH to a running Rex server (API revisions 12–19) on macOS, Linux, or Windows for terminals, new shells, and native Chat.

index.seoTitle: Heeler 文档 — iPhone 与 iPad 上的 Claude Code、Codex、herdr 与 tmux 控制台
index.seoDescription: 在 iPhone 和 iPad 上配置 Heeler，通过 SSH 连接 Herdr TUI、herdr-core、tmux 或 Rex，远程查看并控制 Claude Code、Codex 等编程 Agent。

pairing.seoTitle: 扫码配对 Mac 或 Linux Host（SSH 免手动填表）
pairing.seoDescription: 扫描 Heeler 插件或 npx heeler-pair 生成的一次性配对码，免手动配置 SSH 密钥与指纹，将 iPhone 或 iPad 连接到 Mac 或 Linux Host。

tmux.seoTitle: 通过 SSH 连接 macOS 或 Linux 上的 tmux 服务端
tmux.seoDescription: 在 iPhone 或 iPad 上连接已有的 macOS 或 Linux tmux 3.3+ 服务端，在原生 Chat 中使用 Claude Code、Codex、Grok Build、Pi 和 Oh My Pi（OpenCode 仅提供终端），并支持 hooks 与 Host Helper 通知。

herdr-core.seoTitle: 通过 SSH 连接 herdr-core 与 Herdr 桌面端
herdr-core.seoDescription: 通过 SSH 将 Heeler 连接到 macOS、Linux 或原生 Windows 上的 Herdr 桌面端与无界面 herdr-core，支持原生 Chat，并在 macOS/Linux 上通过 Host Helper 启用通知与 Usage。

windows-setup.seoTitle: Windows 11 配置：OpenSSH 与原生 Herdr TUI
windows-setup.seoDescription: 在 Windows 11 上启用 OpenSSH、放行防火墙并配置原生 Herdr TUI 开机自启，用于 Heeler 实时 Agent 与终端，同时指引 Windows herdr-core 与 Rex 入口。

tailscale.seoTitle: 通过 Tailscale 连接 Heeler（iPhone 无需安装 VPN 应用）
tailscale.seoDescription: 使用 Heeler 内置 Tailscale 节点直接加入 tailnet，iPhone 与 iPad 无需安装 Tailscale 应用也不占用 iOS VPN 通道，并附 Mac 端免 VPN 运行方案。

usage.seoTitle: 查看 Claude Code、Codex 与 Antigravity CLI 用量及小组件
usage.seoDescription: 在 iPhone 与 iPad 的主屏和锁屏小组件上查看 macOS 或 Linux Host 的 Claude Code、Codex 与 Antigravity CLI 额度限制与 30 天 Token 用量。

chat.seoTitle: 在原生 Chat 中使用 Claude Code、Codex 等编程 Agent
chat.seoDescription: 通过 SSH 在 Heeler 原生 Chat 中阅读对话、发送提示、停止运行并用按钮回答 Blocked 提问，支持 Herdr TUI、herdr-core、tmux 及 Rex。

chat-troubleshooting.seoTitle: Chat 疑难排解：Codex --no-daemon 与会话识别问题
chat-troubleshooting.seoDescription: 解决 Heeler Chat 常见问题：没有 Show Chat、Codex 未使用 --no-daemon 启动、无法识别当前对话、自定义配置目录 Account 与 SFTP 上传失败。

rex.seoTitle: 通过 SSH 连接 Rex 服务端
rex.seoDescription: 通过 SSH 将 Heeler 连接到 macOS、Linux 或 Windows 上运行中的 Rex 服务端（API revision 12–19），支持终端、新建 Shell 与原生 Chat。
